decision_basis: Fixed-window dense had the highest DEV Recall@5 (95%) and MRR@5 (0.8500).
Fixed-window dense and structure-aware dense tied at 90% full evidence coverage@5, while structure-aware Recall@5 fell to 90% and Recall@10 fell to 95%.
Structure-aware chunking fixed q010 but regressed q005 and pushed q021 lower.
BM25/RRF fixed q010 but reduced full evidence coverage@5 to 80% and introduced q005, q013, and q016 regressions without fixing q021.
The simpler control therefore has the best measured quality/complexity trade-off on DEV.

reranker_decision.reason: q010 is primarily a fixed-window boundary failure, while q021 is the only remaining pure top-10 ranking failure. One pure ranking case in 20 DEV questions does not justify provider reranking latency and another failure mode in the final path.

known_winner_limitations: q010 exact evidence is rank 9 although page-level recall passes at rank 4.
q021 evidence is rank 8 and misses the top-5 cutoff.
post_test_policy: Run the matching held-out TEST subset once and do not tune retrieval after seeing it.
